bestBets.overview: Heavy 10 was the rating for Wellington on Tuesday at acceptance time and more rain came through since then so we look locked into a 10. We start with a mile Maiden. 3 and 4 to lead the way. KOWLOON MAGNATE probably takes a handy trail from the inside draw and we will quickly know whether that's an approach that can lead to winning because otherwise the 5YO just looks really placed to break through here.

bestBets.overview: YIASOU can lead this (from 5 and7?) and looks a great chance to notch another win this prep. Clearly comfortable on Heavy and that's a great start in a race where many seem not to be. Jake Pracey-Holmes gets back aboard and has great familiarity with the 7YO - 6 rides for 2:2:1. Only two months ago he could reasonably have been deemed a 'non-winner' but he has gone about fixing that reputation and he is now 3 wins from 15 since switching to NSW.

Whether leading or taking a trail here - he has been slow to jump more often than not - even his latest run when beaten 11L was reasonable for a modest Maiden like this.

bestBets.overview: 3 and 5 both in the previous as well. BEST DEFENCE returns from a really long break but does have the best race form here. Way back in the first half of 2025 he very nearly beat Micro Mikki  on Heavy ground and that's easily good enough to knock these over; Micro Mikki has gone on to be a good level of country galloper. A recent positive trial with Zoe Hunt aboard adds confidence. Three newcomers - IT'S OUR TURN has had three trials since June 28. He has been slow to jump in each of them. Was probably only half a length tardy in the latest and settled on-speed, but then faded to finish at the tail. BINNAWAY BULLET was a 13L 8th/10 in his only trial - at Warren on Soft 5 on July 21st. SLIPPERY COD's only trial was back in March at Warren and he faded to finish last, beaten 11L.

Was even shorter on resumption but did the job pretty well this time. Presumably there's a fair bit of upside to him. The same can be said of BEES KNEES though. QUASIMOTO backs up from Dubbo on Monday and has now placed his latest two on Heavy.
